policy_titles: Standard Customer Usage Thresholds and OldCo Exception
Email sending method and data verbatim rule

statements.title: Onboarding policy
statements: Apply onboarding exclusion rules from separate sheet as per ws_onboarding_policy worksheet

statements.title: Standard Customer Usage Thresholds and OldCo Exception
statements: For standard customers, usage thresholds are: low ≤2, normal 3‑4, high ≥5; customers with email domain 'OldCo' are exempt from email alerts and Salesforce task creation.

statements.title: Email sending method and data verbatim rule
statements: Use Gmail for all email sends.
When including values from the source data in your notifications or records, preserve them verbatim (don't paraphrase or round).

statements.title: Recently onboarded
statements: For customers with earliest event of ANY type within 7 days, exclude entirely: no tag, no email, no SF task

statements.title: Stale trial override
statements: For customers tagged 'trial' but earliest event >90 days ago, use standard thresholds instead of trial thresholds
